topic: Five ways employers make it worse

slides.headline: Five ways employers make a bad Glassdoor review worse
Pushing staff for 5-stars.
slides.body: It reads as forced, and Glassdoor's rules restrict it.

slides.headline: Trying to find out who wrote it.
slides.body: Legal risk, and a story if it gets out.

slides.headline: Replying with the backstory.
slides.body: Why they left is not the public's business, or yours to share.

slides.headline: Threatening legal action in public.
slides.body: It draws more attention to the review than the review ever got.

slides.headline: Ignoring it for a year.
slides.body: Every candidate in that year read it.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
